parsed.answer: This has been reported before: the CmdPal Dock performance widgets (CPU/GPU/RAM/network) showing ??? or no data. PowerToys#46216 is the main thread, and #46286 was closed as a duplicate of it. The tickets point to a few things to try. 1) A commenter in #46216 fixed it by clicking each widget in the dock, but others reported that this did not help. 2) A commenter in #48597, a related ticket about the same widgets showing 0 or throwing an index-out-of-range error, found that the cause was a corrupted Windows performance counter database. Task Manager and other monitors also failed to show data. Open an elevated Command Prompt, run `lodctr /R`, then reboot. After that, GPU and network data returned to normal. If Task Manager shows its data correctly, this is less likely to be your cause. 3) In #47527, a similar 0% CPU problem went away after a Windows update, so install pending Windows updates. #46216 and #48680 have no confirmed fix, and the problem was still reported on 0.100.2. If none of this works, add your bug report ZIP and details to #46216 or #48680.
